title: Speed first build plan
eyebrow: Build plan · design approved 2026-11-24 · nothing built yet

short.lead: Six steps, issues #626 to #631 under parent issue #625, make every hook call and the test suite cheaper, each timed before and after. The build plan is the contract: I log any departure from it and report it at the end.
short.hint: Tap a group to see its steps. The Changes section below gives each step's files and done-test.
items: Issue #626. Every later step reports a before and after number from it.
Load less, then one process per phase
Label reads, the log, easy test wins
Issues #629, #630 and #631, each independent once step 1 is done.
Send: Build plan approved: speed first

changes: chg
Step 1: timing script (issue #626)
A script that prints milliseconds per call and saves a baseline.

Done when: one command times a Write and a Bash hook call, the 5 label reads, the Stop judge and each verify.py part, and saves the baseline; a check in tools/verify_tools.py runs it. Touches tools/time_hooks.py and tools/verify_tools.py. Depends on nothing; steps 2 to 6 depend on it.

changes.alt: A script that prints milliseconds per call and saves a baseline.
changes.caption: A script that prints milliseconds per call and saves a baseline.

changes: chg
Step 2: load only the needed part (issue #627)
hook.py imports one module per event instead of all seven.
Done when: the timing script shows a lower per-call time than the baseline and verify.py passes in full. Touches scripts/hook.py. Depends on step 1.

changes.alt: hook.py imports one module per event instead of all seven.
changes.caption: hook.py imports one module per event instead of all seven.

changes: chg
Step 3: one process per phase (issue #628)
Checks before a tool call share one process; checks after share another.

Done when: a Write starts 2 processes instead of 9 and a Bash call 2 instead of 6, a crash in guard or guardwrite still blocks and any other crash fails open and reports, and verify.py passes in full. Touches hooks/hooks.json and scripts/hook.py. Depends on step 2.

changes.alt: Checks before a tool call share one process; checks after share another.
changes.caption: Checks before a tool call share one process; checks after share another.

changes: chg
Step 4: label reads at the same time (issue #629)
The commit gate's 5 reads run in a thread pool; GitHub is read every call.

Done when: the timing script shows the label reads close to one read (about 150 ms against 748 ms), and the comment in design_loop.py about parallel reads is true. Touches scripts/house_rules/design_loop.py and its tests. Depends on step 1.

changes.alt: The commit gate's 5 reads run in a thread pool; GitHub is read every call.
changes.caption: The commit gate's 5 reads run in a thread pool; GitHub is read every call.

changes: chg
Step 5: append-only hook log (issue #630)
One line appended per write; trimmed under a lock.
Done when: a test with parallel writers loses no line and verify.py passes in full. Touches the hook log code in scripts/house_rules/core.py and its tests. Depends on step 1.

changes.alt: One line appended per write; trimmed under a lock.
changes.caption: One line appended per write; trimmed under a lock.

changes: chg
Step 6: easy test wins (issue #631)
Quick, safe speedups to verify.py chosen from step 1's timings.

Done when: verify.py's total time falls against the baseline with every check still present, and what is left for the code-quality phase is listed in the issue. Touches scripts/checks/common.py and the parts the timings point to. Depends on step 1.
chg
Acceptance tests (all steps)
One test per design item, run by the reviewer in acceptance mode before QA.

Done when: each passes with its evidence saved under docs/qa/speed-first/: S1 scope, the timing script shows lower numbers than the baseline for a Write call, a Bash call and the log; S2 labels, the 5 reads run at the same time and GitHub is still read every call; S3 judge, left as it is and its time printed by the script; S4 tests, verify.py total time lower than the baseline with every check still present; S5 docs, version, changelog and the full verify.py run.

wrapup.summary: A six-step build plan for the approved speed work, under parent issue #625.
wrapup.changing: A new timing script in tools/, then changes to hook.py, hooks.json, the commit gate, the hook log and the test helpers. No check is removed or weakened.
